label: The selected modal holder and the scope of actual existence
summary: The existing actual-absence theorem supplies NECESSARY_2 for the same concrete holder that exists at the actual world and an accessible joint-absence world. It uses no frame condition and allows replacements. The witness from P1-prime does not derive actuality or concreteness of every power-holder. A rigid necessary natural substrate is compatible with the necessity conclusion in a positive-production reading. See docs/notes/pruss-power-premises.md, section 11.
blocker: The power-grounding rule for a collective negative outcome, the serious-actualist rule for every holder, and causal rather than abstract initiation remain independent commitments on the supplied frame. Applying root uniqueness to identify a giver also needs that giver to occupy the root role.
